protocol.statistical_unit: user; support repetitions averaged within user

config.policy_features: 12 current-subset probabilities, normalized entropy, top-two margin
config.split_seed: 33000 + fold*100 + class; ascending sample IDs before permutation
config.gain_target: correctness after requesting a superset minus current correctness
config.action_ties: stop, fewer additional views, smaller subset index; tolerance 1e-12
config.price_ties: higher macro accuracy, lower mean views, higher price; tolerance 1e-12
config.strong_simple_rule: candidate must gain >=2pp and improve >=6/8 users against EACH comparator; no target winner selection
config.cost_fairness_rule: candidate population mean views must not exceed either adaptive comparator population mean; fixed mixture uses candidate cost as ceiling
config.aggregation: each user receives equal weight for primary accuracy and cost; per-user cost matching is descriptive only
config.runtime_rule: no speedup claim without a separate actual on-demand total-runtime benchmark
config.validation_reuse_limit: policy user had no encoder gradient updates, but was reused for encoder checkpoint selection
